channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Wilson ref Thompson earns first shot at NCHSAA title game
item.description: As two Wilson schools chase NCHSAA football titles, longtime resident Chris Thompson earns his first championship assignment as back judge in the 7-A final between Clayton and Grimsley.

item.title: Warriors’ ‘Dirty Thirty’ look to make history
item.description: Hunt High’s “Dirty Thirty” chases its first football state title, facing six-time champion Crest in the 5-A final as an undersized, doubted squad built on brotherhood and belief.

item.title: ‘Just another game’ for Warriors, Chargers is state 5-A final
item.description: Underdog Hunt “Dirty Thirty” embraces “just another game” mantra as it faces Crest in the NCHSAA 5-A football final, led by star playmakers and a reliable all-around kicker.

item.title: Children treated at Shop with a Cop
item.description: At Saturday's Shop with a Cop, officers, donors and volunteers took 70 children Christmas shopping at Walmart, giving local families a fun holiday experience.

item.title: ArtSpin events draw visitors downtown
item.description: ArtSpin’s Downtown Christmas Celebration brought hundreds to downtown Wilson with live music, train rides, kids’ activities and visits with Santa and Mrs. Claus.

item.title: Tractor pull recognized with awards
item.description: This year's truck and tractor pull at the Wilson County Fairgrounds received accolades from the United Pullers of The Carolinas.

item.title: Down to Business: New boxing gym takes a swing at Wilson
item.description: Hosam Muharam has opened his new boxing gym, Fight Night Sport Center, as a training facility aimed at building a hometown champion while keeping fitness, safety and affordability in focus.

item.title: N.C. State pushes No. 19 Kansas to OT but still searching for that signature win
item.description: N.C. State takes No. 19 Kansas to OT behind Darrion Williams’ clutch shooting but falls 77-76 as Melvin Council Jr. erupts for 36, leaving Will Wade still searching for a signature Wolfpack win.

item.title: Area Calendar, Dec. 15-16, 2025
item.description: Area basketball schedule for Dec. 15-16 features a full slate of boys, girls and JV games, highlighted by Fike at J.H. Rose and Wilson Prep at Hoggard.

item.title: Bulldogs rally from 9 down to top Shorter 93-87
item.description: Barton rallies from 9 down as reserves Sean Quick-Streeter and Jaylen Faber score 26 each in a 93-87 win over Shorter, snapping a skid and giving the Bulldogs their first Conference Carolinas victory ahead of rival Mount Olive’s visit.
